type: Fresh complete actual-file mathematical audit, with exactly scoped source reuse and current-batch primary checks
checks: W is over F_q, so ordinary F_q-unit fixed frames and the semilinear deck character have the stated coefficient typing.
The d-fold composite of Phi defines the F_q-unit map; categorical semilinear deck descent has d-cocycle one without imposing a false split relation on a based coset lift.
Factoring into e=f/d p-stages on the degree-td resolution cover costs O(f t r^2), with fixed normal depth and equation degree.
Twisted determinant classes are counted on U_H before the degree-d field-kernel cover, avoiding an extra d factor; at most r+1 determinant extensions per stage.
The final deck pullback preserves the two affine charts, normal order, slopes and fixed cohomology dimensions, and contributes only fixed linear coefficients.
Actual all-ring families, finite paired unit jets, specified-isomorphism lifting and nilpotent finite-etale invariance give open-and-closed unit classes.
Twisted Shapiro formula and its conjugacy correction are correct for the stated left-coset convention; continuity and fixed field character retained.
Distinct crown coordinates give distinct A-conjugacy classes; at most |GL_r(F_q)| such S-classes in an ambient conjugacy class suffices.
Injective outer P action and transitivity make L monolithic primitive; d(P)<=2g and the exact LMT c+2 threshold apply.
Natural centre-free SL_(p^a) example satisfies the existing faithful-linear/order bound, excluding the explicitly nonsimple small cases.
